Have you ever had a lucid dream? If so, what was it about?
I have, but it's hard to place any of them as "about" something.
I had a dream once where I figured out that I was dreaming and got so excited that I woke up. That was a bit annoying. Other than that, I can't say I've had one.

I did it and it was quite the experience. What had happened was I fell asleep during the day with the radio on. I had been exhausted because I have a late night job and at the time I had this early morning job so I had been running on fumes. When I fell asleep I came to this realization of "where am I" then I am looking around in my dream and I ask myself "why am I at my campus? I thought I was at home?" and I could hear the radio on in the background which I thought was odd. The dream played out and I ended up running up this flight of stairs to catch up with someone who I had lost contact with a while ago. I ran up to her and was excited to see her and greeted her, after our brief conversation she left and I walked back downstairs. A few moments later I realize what is going on and it registers that I am dreaming and I started to control my dream in a way. I was able to walk in directions I desired and look around. I didn't talk to anyone, there were people around me in my dream but I didn't know them so I didn't want to bother them (reading this now it sounds silly). Then shortly after I was woken up slightly confused, it was quite the experience. It felt refreshing for some reason a bit after I had woken up and was able to process what had happened.

Oklahoman here. Tornados are no fucking joke. A few years back, I went with my church to do some disaster relief for a town that got hit with a huge one. Metal dumpsters were embedded in the side of buildings like ornaments on a tree and cars were completely overturned and demolished on the streets. The craziest things I saw were a vinyl record embedded halfway through a telephone pole, and straws of hay stuck in the side of the remnants of a barn, much resembling needles in a pin cushion. Even the smallest categorized one, an F1, can strip the bark off a tree with as much ease as you and I can peel a banana. They are deadly and it is nearly impossible to determine their path or duration. One side of a street can be completely leveled with homes reduced to splinters, while the other side will look nearly untouched. They are the pure embodiment of force and power.

You think Bill Paxton ran around at the end of Twister like a fucking panicked squirrel for fun? You think it's cool to sit on your porch with sweet tea and a spittoon and post videos to Facebook of those dark, abysmal clouds rolling over you? Think again. If you get tornados in your area, have a contingency plan memorized for you and those closest to you. Know where your local tornado shelters are located, because tornados can and will kill you without hesitation.
